detail.longDescription: I tried to follow the AI agent instructions but need additional assistance. The instructions state that I need to add ChatGPT as a "custom SAML app" from the Admin Console. When I do this, there are two options: 1) Download metadata 2) "Copy the SSO URL, entity ID and certificate". I am guessing that I should opt for #2, but where do I obtain that information from my ChatGPT account?
